desc:
A cryptarithm is an addition a + b = c in which every letter stands for a decimal digit. Different letters must stand for different digits and the same letter always stands for the same digit. A word with more than one letter cannot start with the digit 0 (a one-letter word may be 0).

Given three words a, b and c of upper-case letters, return the number of ways to assign digits to the letters so that the number written by a plus the number written by b equals the number written by c.

a = "SEND", b = "MORE", c = "MONEY"  →  1   (9567 + 1085 = 10652)
a = "A", b = "A", c = "B"           →  4   (A = 1..4, B = 2A)
a = "AB", b = "AB", c = "AB"        →  0
constraints: All words consist of the letters A-Z
At most 10 different letters occur in the three words together
hints: With at most 10 letters there are at most 10! = 3,628,800 assignments. That is too slow to check each one in full, so use the structure of addition.

Process the columns from the least significant digit. In one column, once the digits of the two addends and the incoming carry are known, the digit of the result is forced: (da + db + carry) % 10, and the new carry is (da + db + carry) // 10.

Walk the columns right to left. In each column assign only letters not yet seen, let the sum letter be determined (or checked) by the formula, reject clashes with digits already in use, and respect the no-leading-zero rule. After the last column the carry must be 0.
editorial: Do not enumerate permutations of all letters. Add the numbers the way you do on paper, column by column from the right, and let the search branch only on letters that appear for the first time. In a column with addend letters x, y and sum letter z, choose digits for the unseen addend letters (trying the unused digits), and then z has to be (dx + dy + carry) % 10: it is either already assigned (check equality) or free (check that the digit is unused). Continue with carry (dx + dy + carry) // 10 into the next column. Columns beyond the end of a word count as digit 0. Once every column is processed the carry must be 0, which also makes the result exactly a + b = c.

A letter fixed in an early column prunes everything later, so the number of search nodes stays small even with 10 letters. Leading letters of words longer than one character are simply never given the digit 0. Different letters get different digits, so the count of assignments is the count of distinct solutions.
time: O(10^k) worst case for k letters, strongly pruned
